units.i2v_prompt: Single continuous take at 24fps, 16:9. A locked-off medium close-up at the museum display glass, the framing stays exactly as the first frame and the camera holds perfectly still. A young woman in a cream knit sweater stands in profile facing the vitrine, her head held in the same profile angle from the first frame to the last, chin level, jaw relaxed; a carved stone relief sits dimly behind the glass; warm tungsten halogen from the case lights the near side of her face at 3000K while the room falls to warm black. Her lips stay together and closed through the whole take, as in the first frame. At the start her eyes travel slowly along one carved line on the relief. Around one second her eyelids close once and open again, unhurried, roughly seven frames closed, and after that her gaze lifts a little toward her own faint reflection in the glass where it settles. Near the end her shoulders settle slightly as she lets one breath out. Only her eyes, her eyelids and that small shoulder settle move; her head, jaw, lips and hands stay still. Fine 35mm grain, warm halation along the glass edge, black point slightly lifted, warm natural skin, the same museum hall and the same lighting as the first frame.
